lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li4Sn4 (LiSn) crystallizes in the triclinic space group P1, with eight atoms in the unit cell distributed over eight independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Li centers with six Sn neighbors, while Sn environments include 6-, 7-, and 8-coordinate coordination with mixed Li and Sn neighbors, with Li–Sn distances ranging from about 2.79 to 3.35 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component, and validated polyhedron contacts show corner- and edge-sharing between Sn 7- and 8-vertex coordination polyhedra.
